projects.title: Personal Portfolio
projects.description: Build a responsive personal portfolio website to showcase your skills, projects, education, and contact information using clean HTML and modern CSS.
projects.details: Design and build a fully responsive personal portfolio website. Include sections for About, Skills, Projects, and Contact. Focus on clean layout, responsive design, semantic HTML, and modern CSS styling.

projects.title: Weather App
projects.description: Create a weather application that fetches real-time weather data from an API, allowing users to search for any city and display temperature, humidity, wind speed, and weather conditions.
projects.details: Build a weather application that allows users to search for any city and display current weather information using a public Weather API. Handle invalid city names and display weather icons dynamically.

projects.title: E-Commerce Website
projects.description: Develop a fully responsive e-commerce website featuring product listings, shopping cart functionality, category filtering, and a complete modern shopping experience.
projects.details: Develop a complete responsive e-commerce frontend including product listing, product details, shopping cart, filtering, searching, and checkout UI using JavaScript without any backend.

projects.title: Student API
projects.description: Build a RESTful Student Management API that supports creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving student records while following clean backend architecture.
projects.details: Create RESTful CRUD APIs to manage student records. Users should be able to add, update, delete, and retrieve students. Validate all incoming requests and organize routes properly.

projects.title: Authentication System
projects.description: Develop a secure authentication system with user registration, login, password encryption, JWT authentication, and protected routes for authorized users.
projects.details: Implement a complete authentication system with user registration, login, password hashing, JWT authentication, protected routes, and user authorization.

projects.title: Hospital System
projects.description: Create a hospital management backend that manages patients, doctors, appointments, and medical records with secure authentication and role-based access.
projects.details: Build a backend system to manage patients, doctors, and appointments. Include authentication, appointment scheduling, patient records, and role-based access control.

projects.title: Coffee Shop UI
projects.description: Design a modern and visually appealing landing page for a coffee shop with attractive layouts, typography, colors, and responsive UI components.
projects.details: Design a modern coffee shop landing page in Figma. Create a consistent color palette, typography system, call-to-action sections, and responsive layouts following UI design principles.

projects.title: Food Delivery App UI
projects.description: Design a complete mobile food delivery application including user flow, restaurant pages, shopping cart, checkout process, and interactive prototypes.
projects.details: Design a complete food delivery mobile application including onboarding, authentication, home page, restaurant details, cart, checkout, and order tracking screens with interactive prototype.

projects.title: Banking Dashboard
projects.description: Create a professional banking dashboard that displays financial information, user accounts, transaction history, analytics, and modern user experience principles.
projects.details: Create a professional banking dashboard that displays account balance, transactions, analytics, and user profile. Focus on user experience, accessibility, and consistent design components.

projects.title: BMI Calculator
projects.description: Build a Flutter BMI Calculator calculates Body Mass Index based on user input and displays health categories with a clean interface.
projects.details: Develop a BMI Calculator application in Flutter where users enter their height and weight, calculate BMI instantly, and receive health status based on the result.

projects.title: Notes App
projects.description: Develop a Notes application using Flutter that allows users to create, edit, delete, search, and organize notes while storing data locally.
projects.details: Build a Notes application that allows users to create, edit, delete, search, and organize notes. Store all notes locally using SQLite and implement proper state management.

projects.title: E-Commerce App
projects.description: Create a complete Flutter e-commerce app including authentication, product browsing, and order management.
projects.details: Create a complete e-commerce mobile application using Flutter and Firebase. Include authentication, product catalog, shopping cart, favorites, orders, and real-time database integration.

projects.title: Sales Dashboard
projects.description: Analyze sales datasets and build interactive dashboards using Excel and Power BI to visualize business performance and key sales metrics.
projects.details: Analyze sales data using Excel and Power BI. Clean the dataset, create KPIs, charts, and interactive dashboards to visualize sales performance and business trends.

projects.title: Customer Analytics
projects.description: Use Python to analyze customer data, perform data cleaning and visualization, then segment customers into meaningful groups based on purchasing behavior.
projects.details: Use Python to clean customer data, perform exploratory data analysis, and segment customers into groups based on purchasing behavior using clustering techniques.

projects.title: BI Dashboard
projects.description: Build a complete Business Intelligence solution by collecting, cleaning, analyzing, and visualizing business data using SQL, Python, and Power BI dashboards.
projects.details: Build an end-to-end business intelligence solution. Collect data from multiple sources, clean and analyze it using Python and SQL, then create an interactive Power BI dashboard with meaningful insights.

motivationMessages.message: Great job! You're making steady progress. Stay consistent and you'll achieve your goals soon!
Keep learning, keep growing. You're doing great!
One step at a time — you're closer to your goal than yesterday.
Every lesson you finish is a brick in your future. Keep building!
Progress, not perfection. You're exactly where you need to be.
Small daily wins add up to big results. Don't stop now!
You showed up today — that's how skills are built.
Challenges are just proof that you're growing. Push through!
Your future self will thank you for the effort you're putting in today.
Consistency beats motivation. Keep showing up, and the results will follow.
